title: Ordering at a café
setting: You walk up to the counter at a busy coffee shop in Seattle.

turns.npc: Hi there! What can I get started for you?
turns.n: Order a medium iced latte, politely.
turns.a: Can I get a medium iced latte, please?
alts: Could I get a medium iced latte, please?
Can I have a medium iced latte, please?
I'll have a medium iced latte, please.
turns.tip: "Can I get...?" is the most natural way to order. "I want..." sounds too direct.

turns.npc: Sure thing! Do you want any milk alternatives, like oat or almond?
turns.n: Say no, regular milk is fine.
turns.a: No, regular milk is fine, thanks.
turns.tip: "I'm good, thanks" is a natural way to say no to an offer.

turns.npc: Is that for here or to go?
turns.tip: Short answers sound natural. You don't need a full sentence.

turns.n: Hand over cash and let them keep the change.
turns.a: Here you go. Keep the change.
alts: Here you go, keep the change.
turns.tip: "Here you go" = you give something to someone.

turns.npc: Thanks so much! Have a great day!
turns.n: Thank them and wish the same back.
turns.tip: "You too!" is the automatic response to "Have a great day!"
